title: 2 Keys Keyboard
goal: Reach exactly n letters using the fewest Copy All and Paste operations.
strategy: A copy followed by pastes multiplies the current count. Splitting a composite multiplier into its prime factors never costs more operations, so the optimum is the sum of prime factors with multiplicity.
